inputs: canonical channel asset and institutional owner
directed sender/recipient information-channel relationship selected through that asset
one finite message-slot capacity account per channel/scope/period
optional separate finite verification slots and named procedure
procedure: Validate canonical entities, ownership and directed channel references. Require identical units and dated scope, distinct channel/verification roles, and complete demand mappings. Deny absent reach, unavailable information or explicit access/disclosure denial. Withhold all competing claims on unknown inputs. Stage channel slots and optional one-to-one verification slots atomically through the shared allocator. Retain prior postings, holds and additional/unmet quantities without delivery, verification or time advancement.
independent_oracle: Enumerate 81 combinations of zero through two channel and verification slots and one through three messages for each of two demands. Independently enumerate feasible integer pairs and select the lexicographic maximum under explicit school-first precedence.
limits: No truth, trust or behavior effect
No application payload or network access
No source activation, numerical IPC or parent/cumulative acceptance
review_route: SV separate author inspection; independent agent review deferred
